accessDenied: Only Super Admins can manage feature flags.
introBody: The switch sets the global value. The tenant list chooses who receives an override. Reserved flags (Peppol) stay off.

descriptions.EnableNewPaymentFlow: Alternate payment path in PaymentService. Default off.
descriptions.EnableDepExportV2: DEP export sets the header X-Regkasse-Dep-Export-Schema: v2. The BMF JSON body stays the same.
descriptions.EnableOnlineOrdersV2: Online orders are marked intakeVersion v2.
descriptions.EnableAutoAusfall: TSE failover may enqueue a FON Ausfall immediately when Ausfall:AutoEnqueue is on.
descriptions.fiscalRksvAt: Austrian RKSV signing. Locked on for AT.
descriptions.fiscalKassenSicherheitDe: German KassenSichV. Profile default off until that package is production-ready.
descriptions.fiscalMwstCh: Swiss VAT. On for CH profiles.
descriptions.eInvoicingEn16931: EN 16931 / UBL. On for EU_DEFAULT. Does not gate reverse-charge tax.
descriptions.eInvoicingPeppol: Peppol send. Reserved and off until package 22-b-5 promotes the name.
